g.text: Thin views over object oriented TypeScript
React components. Thin: they render state and call actions.
A zustand store mirrors domain state so React can subscribe.
Add a language: catalog.ts + a loader in LanguageRegistry
Add a runner: extend Runner, register in RunnerRegistry
